queries: WITH order_averages AS (SELECT order_id, AVG(CAST(product_quantity AS DECIMAL(19,4))) AS order_avg FROM Order_Items GROUP BY order_id), overall AS (SELECT AVG(CAST(product_quantity AS DECIMAL(19,4))) AS overall_avg FROM Order_Items) SELECT oa.order_id, oa.order_avg AS average_quantity, oa.order_avg - o.overall_avg AS difference FROM order_averages oa CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE o.overall_avg IS NOT NULL ORDER BY CASE WHEN oa.order_avg IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, difference DESC LIMIT 10

alternatives.interpretation: The overall average is the average of the per-order averages, giving each order equal weight.
